errors.evidence: The chart is a horizontal bar chart, so the categories are on the vertical axis, not the horizontal axis.
The categories are not sorted in alphabetical order; they are sorted in ascending order based on their percentage values.

The list of categories provided is incomplete. It omits several sectors shown in the chart, including 'ИКТ, комуникации, софтуерен бизнес' (the lowest value), 'Транспорт', and 'Строителство' (the highest value).

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос показва процентите на скритата икономика
errors.evidence: The chart is a horizontal bar chart, so the percentages (values) are represented along the horizontal axis, not the vertical axis.

errors.text_span: Мащабът е линейен, започващ от 0 и достигащ до 10,9%, с равномерно разположени интервали на всеки 5%, отбелязани на оста.
errors.evidence: This description of the axis scale is entirely fabricated. The scale does not end at 10.9% (the maximum value is 82.6%), and there are no tick marks or intervals shown on the axis at all.
While the axis scale begins at 0, the lowest data value presented in the chart is 10.9% for the 'ИКТ, комуникации, софтуерен бизнес' category. Stating 0% as the lowest value is misleading.
